prompt: The Sikh empire's capital at the time of the Battle of Sobraon came under the rule of the British Crown in what year?
answer: The capital was **Lahore**, which was annexed by the British in **1849** after the Second Anglo-Sikh War. (Direct rule by the British Crown formally began in **1858**, when the East India Company’s territories were transferred to the Crown.)
